svg.title: Alpha decay
svg.desc: Before: a parent nucleus. After: a daughter nucleus with two fewer protons and two fewer neutrons, and an alpha particle (two protons and two neutrons) moving away. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Alpha decay conserves nucleon count, charge and momentum
U-238 → Th-234 + He-4. The two-body recoil uses masses proportional to A; sizes and speeds are
schematic. The alpha is not drawn as a pre-existing orbiting object.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
